text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
ALRIIIIIIIGHT, LET'S GOOOOO! It's finally 
here, the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh my? Trainer, you seem a bit down 
in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"‘This precious moment when we finally 
met, With all my heart, thank you.’"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I have waited for so, so long... For I am 
Colorful Phantasia."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is a live performance song exclusive 
to the Tiara route. ...It is the song that 
will be performed at this Shuka Sho as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, doesn't listening to songs fill you 
with energy? Besides, this song is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it sound like a song written just 
for us? For a princess and... her prince.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. I am a princess, after all! I 
shall mow down my enemies one after 
another♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And tonight, I shall sing for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So please look forward to it, Trainer-san!
